messages:
zara: Heads-up: DAST run for release branch failed to upload scan evidence to the secure bucket. Investigating — looks like recent KMS rotation removed the old key used to decrypt archived findings. link: https://ci.redwood.example/build/7812 :warning:
hugo: that sounds bad. We rely on archived artifacts for triage and compliance. What does the error show?
mei: error from artifact service:
```
ERROR: decrypt failed: NotFound: KeyVersion not found or key disabled
  at keystore.Decrypt (keystore_client.go:140)
  at artifacts.Store (artifacts/store.go:88)
```
security-bot: created evidence ticket SEC-EVID-2026-210 for failed artifact uploads.
zara: timeline: key rotation pushed at 08:00 UTC. DAST ran at 08:05 and attempted to decrypt previous temp tokens to attach provenance. Rotation removed ability to access older ciphertexts.
hugo: can we re-run the scanner to repro and produce fresh encrypted artifacts with the new key? Compliance may require original artifact chain though.
mei: re-run possible but we lose original timestamps/hashes. Also KMS policy now forbids decrypt with previous key version because we rotated and disabled it per policy.
zara: options: (A) temporarily re-enable old key version to export/decrypt artifacts (needs approvals + audit) (B) accept re-run and store additional provenance notes (C) escalate to compliance for exception. Thoughts?
audit-bot: note: any key re-enable will generate a mandatory audit record and requires two approvers from {sec, compliance}.
hugo: I prefer B as safe but we need to capture justification and flag in the postmortem. If compliance insists on original artifacts, we may need A.
mei: short-term: re-run DAST and stash artifacts; I'll also collect KMS rotation logs and snapshot key policy. zara, can you open an incident record?
zara: opening incident SEC-INC-2026-77 and will attach SEC-EVID-2026-210 and KMS logs. Follow-ups: 1) adjust rotation playbook to ensure compatibility with artifact retention, 2) add CI preflight to check key version availability before rotation, 3) tweak DAST to re-encrypt with new key upon rotation window.
hugo: agreed. tagging @compliance for visibility.
summary: DAST artifact uploads failed after KMS key rotation removed access to older key versions; team chose to re-run scans for fresh artifacts and opened incident/evidence tickets; follow-ups include rotation/playbook fixes and CI preflight checks.
